mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital and increases liquidity in financial markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 9.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in housing starts below 500,000 units signals a collapse in residential investment and weak consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST < 500.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate indicates a broad-based economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where both INDPRO and UNRATE decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 330,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth prospects and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS < 330000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.0% per annum, combined with a stagnant federal funds rate, signals rising inflation expectations that trigger a flight to real assets and equity market volatility, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 11,000 billion dollars signals a deepening recession, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 < 11000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a rise in the unemployment rate indicates a labor market collapse that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
